# Resy Blog

> > The official blog of Resy, featuring restaurant openings, hit lists, and dining guides across major cities worldwide.

Resy Blog (Right This Way) covers the latest restaurant openings, curated dining recommendations, and city-specific guides for reservations made through the Resy platform. The blog highlights new restaurants joining Resy across markets including New York, Austin, London, Los Angeles, and The Hamptons, with a focus on trending cuisines like Japanese fusion, smokehouse BBQ, and innovative cocktail bars.

## Key Topics

- Resy platform
- Restaurant openings
- New York dining
- Austin restaurants
- London dining
- Japanese fusion
- Hamptons dining
- Restaurant recommendations
- Hit lists
- Shoreditch
- Texas BBQ
- Cocktail bars
- Izakaya
- Los Angeles dining
- Restaurant guides

## New Restaurant Openings

- [New on Resy: Tayēr + Elementary, Trangallan, Coqfighter](https://blog.resy.com/2019/06/new-on-resy-tayer-elementary-trangallan-coqfighter): London restaurant openings: Tayēr + Elementary in Shoreditch & more
- [Wayan, Little Alley, Russ & Daughters Brooklyn, Now on The Resy Hit List](https://blog.resy.com/2019/02/new-york-resy-hit-list-restaurants-wayan): NYC Hit List: Wayan by Cedric Vongerichten & new restaurant openings
- [New on Resy: Rose Cafe, Shibumi, BS Taqueria, and More](https://blog.resy.com/2018/04/new-resy-la-restaurants-04-18): LA restaurant openings: Rose Cafe, Shibumi, BS Taqueria join Resy
- [New on Resy: Barley Swine, Holy Roller, Intero, and More](https://blog.resy.com/2018/02/new-resy-austin): Austin restaurants join Resy: Barley Swine, Holy Roller, Intero & more
- [New On Resy: Orasay, Smoke & Salt and Corazon](https://blog.resy.com/2019/03/new-resy-orasay-smoke-salt-restaurant): Spring London openings: Orasay, Smoke & Salt, Corazon join Resy
- [New on Resy: Le Coq Rico, The Four Horsemen, Davelle, and More](https://blog.resy.com/2018/06/new-resy-restaurants-new-york-06-18): NYC restaurants join Resy: Le Coq Rico, The Four Horsemen, Davelle
